event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Distributed to tribes in Washington, North Dakota, Wyoming, and in Guatemala.

products.product_description: Canned Salmon in unlabeled 8oz metal cans. Cans are packaged into a case of 92 cans. The case label is read: "Canned Salmon***Product of U.S.A. Net. Wt. 62 lbs. Packed by: Faith Harvest Helpers 12643 Case Rd SW Olympia, WA 98512***"
products.code_info: The product can be traced from an unopened labeled case of canned salmon. If the case has been open, there is no way to distinguish the difference between good and bad. The can is a solid color with no labeling or coding. Exp. 1/11/21, 1/12/21, 2/7/21, 2/25/21.
products.reason_for_recall: All canned salmon manufactured by YWAM Faith Harvest Helpers is recalled due to the firm not having a scheduled process for manufacturing the low-acid canned food product.
